title: Gog and Magog
lead: Magog first appears as a son of Japheth in the table of nations (Genesis 10:2). Ezekiel 38–39 makes "Gog, of the land of Magog" the leader of a last great attack on God's people, and Revelation 20:8 turns Gog and Magog into the nations gathered for the final battle. Their identity has been argued over for two thousand years.
